interaction_pattern.front: Visual-first product world. Large pen, colour, texture, short emotional hook.
interaction_pattern.hover_or_tap: Reveal outcome, feeling and one-line transformation.
interaction_pattern.expanded_view: Show What it is, Outcome, Feeling, Transformation, then verified clinical/science content.
interaction_pattern.rule: Outcome and emotion lead. Clinical detail follows. Never invent medical claims.

products.name: Total Body Reset
products.front_hook: A different chapter with your weight.
products.what_it_is: A weight-management care pathway built around Retatrutide.
products.outcome: A lighter, more in-control relationship with your body and weight goals.
products.feeling: More capable. More in control. Less stuck.
products.transformation: From feeling trapped in the same cycle to feeling like your body is finally moving in the direction you want.
products.card_back_copy: For when you want a real reset in how your body feels, looks and responds. Built around a doctor-led pathway, with the goal of helping you feel lighter, more in control and more confident in the next chapter.
short_benefit_lines: More control around your body goals

products.name: Craving Control
products.front_hook: Stop letting food take up so much space in your head.
products.what_it_is: A doctor-led appetite and weight-management pathway built around Tirzepatide.
products.outcome: Less mental noise around food and more freedom to get on with your day.
products.transformation: From food constantly occupying your attention to feeling like you have room in your head for everything else.
products.card_back_copy: For when cravings, appetite or food thoughts feel louder than you want them to. The outcome is not just eating less. It is feeling less mentally consumed by food and more able to focus on your life.

products.name: Body Sculpt
products.front_hook: Less of what you don’t want. More of the shape you do.
products.what_it_is: A body-composition pathway built around Tesamorelin.
products.outcome: A body shape that feels closer to the one you want to see and live in.
products.transformation: From feeling dissatisfied with body composition to feeling more at home in your shape.
products.card_back_copy: For when the goal is not simply weight loss, but shape. This pathway is about helping you move toward a body composition that feels more intentional, more defined and more like you.

products.name: The Glow Up
products.front_hook: Look as good as you want to feel.
products.what_it_is: A skin and appearance-focused peptide stack.
products.outcome: Skin that looks brighter, fresher and more alive.
products.transformation: From looking tired or flat to feeling like your outside finally matches how good you want to feel inside.
products.card_back_copy: For when you want to look in the mirror and see more life looking back. The Glow Up is about radiance, freshness and that visible sense that you are taking care of yourself.
short_benefit_lines: More confidence in how you look

products.name: Skin Rewind
products.front_hook: When you want the mirror to look a little kinder.
products.what_it_is: A skin-focused pathway built around GHK-Cu 50mg.
products.feeling: Refreshed. Restored. Better in your skin.
products.transformation: From seeing tiredness and wear in the mirror to seeing a fresher, more cared-for version of yourself.
products.card_back_copy: For when your skin feels like it is showing more stress than you want it to. Skin Rewind is positioned around helping you feel fresher, more restored and better when you catch your reflection.

products.name: Skin Rewind Reserve
products.what_it_is: The higher-strength Skin Rewind pathway built around GHK-Cu 100mg.
products.outcome: A more premium, intensive skin-support experience.
products.transformation: From wanting basic skin support to choosing a more elevated, deliberate approach to how your skin looks and feels.
products.card_back_copy: For someone who wants the more elevated version of the Skin Rewind experience. Same visual world, but positioned as the premium, more intensive path.

products.name: Holiday Tan
products.front_hook: That just-got-back look, without waiting for the holiday.
products.what_it_is: A tanning-focused pathway built around Melanotan II.
products.outcome: A sun-kissed look that feels like you have just come back from somewhere good.
products.transformation: From pale, flat or wintery to looking like life has been a little sunnier lately.
products.card_back_copy: For when you want that just-back-from-holiday look. The emotional outcome is simple: warmer, fresher, more sun-kissed and more alive.

products.name: All-Day Energy
products.front_hook: Still have something left when the day isn’t finished yet.
products.what_it_is: An energy-focused pathway built around MOTS-c.
products.outcome: More usable energy across the day.
products.transformation: From fading before the day is done to feeling like you still have something left for work, training, people and life.
products.card_back_copy: For when your day keeps going after your energy has checked out. The goal is simple: feel like you have more left in the tank when you still have things you want to do.

products.name: Deep Sleep Rebuild
products.what_it_is: A sleep and recovery-focused pathway built around CJC-1295 and Ipamorelin.
products.transformation: From getting through the night to waking up feeling like the night actually did something for you.
products.card_back_copy: For when sleep technically happens, but recovery does not feel like it does. The outcome is a night that feels more restorative and a morning that feels less like recovery from sleep itself.

products.name: Rapid Recovery
products.front_hook: Get back to doing what you love sooner.
products.outcome: Less time feeling sidelined and more time feeling ready to move again.
products.transformation: From feeling held back by recovery to feeling like you can return to the things your body lets you enjoy.
products.card_back_copy: For when being out of action is the part you hate most. Rapid Recovery is emotionally about getting back to movement, training, routine and the parts of life that make you feel like yourself.

products.name: Age Defiance
products.front_hook: Getting older doesn’t have to mean feeling older.
products.what_it_is: A longevity and vitality-focused pathway built around NAD+.
products.outcome: More vitality and a stronger sense of staying engaged with life.
products.transformation: From feeling like age is becoming the story to feeling like you still have plenty of story left.
products.card_back_copy: For when you are less interested in your age than in how you feel living it. Age Defiance is positioned around vitality, presence and staying fully engaged in the life you are already building.
short_benefit_lines: A more capable sense of ageing

products.name: Hormone Reset
products.front_hook: When you haven’t quite felt like yourself lately.
products.what_it_is: A hormone-focused pathway built around Kisspeptin.
products.outcome: A greater sense of rhythm, balance and feeling like yourself again.
products.transformation: From feeling subtly off or disconnected from yourself to feeling more settled in your own rhythm again.
products.card_back_copy: For that hard-to-describe feeling that something is just off. The transformation is not about becoming someone new. It is about feeling more like yourself again.

products.name: Bedroom Confidence
products.front_hook: Want it again. Feel wanted again.
products.what_it_is: An intimacy-focused pathway built around PT-141.
products.outcome: More confidence, desire and presence in intimate moments.
products.transformation: From feeling disconnected from intimacy to feeling like that part of you has a place in your life again.
products.card_back_copy: For when intimacy has gone quieter than you want it to. The outcome is not performance for performance’s sake. It is confidence, desire, presence and feeling connected to that part of yourself again.
short_benefit_lines: A stronger sense of desire and presence

products.name: Sharp Mind
products.front_hook: For the days when you want your brain properly switched on.
products.what_it_is: A focus and mental-performance pathway built around Semax.
products.outcome: Clearer thinking and a stronger sense of mental sharpness.
products.transformation: From foggy, scattered or mentally flat to feeling like your brain is working with you again.
products.card_back_copy: For the days when your brain is technically present but not really helping. Sharp Mind is about clarity, focus and feeling properly switched on again.

products.name: Gut Reset
products.front_hook: When you’d like to stop thinking about your stomach all the time.
products.what_it_is: A gut-focused pathway built around KPV.
products.outcome: A calmer-feeling gut and less mental attention spent on digestive discomfort.
products.transformation: From constantly noticing your stomach to getting through more of the day without thinking about it.
products.card_back_copy: For when your stomach occupies too much attention. The emotional outcome is simple: feeling more settled, less preoccupied and more able to get on with your day.
